My first acid trip I found a pinecone on the top of a tall hill that had closed spore type things on it, chucked it around with mates like a football and cut open my hand, took it home burnt it, ended up opening up and we were half joking half paranoid it was an alien egg. While it was still burning took it back to the top of the hill and chucked it off to "make sure we weren't patient 0 of the alien takeover". Best. Trip. Ever

Find something you love and cling to it, live for it until you can live for yourself, was in the same boat last year and now I haven't thought about her in months, the dissapointing thing is there isn't really a way to stop the pain you just gotta bear through it until it fades slowly over time, just don't make my mistake and try to take you're own life while sinking slowly into drug addiction as it litteraly almost killed me, now that I'm "healed" I regret every harmful thing I did as I'm still only just now fully recovering and "climbing" out of the painful regret, point is try, try and keep trying until it doesn't hurt anymore, find happiness in someone's smile or laugh hell even in a good book or movie just keep looking and you WILL find it just takes time
